task.description:
Design the migration and scheduler fix for ISS-101: Allow FAILED in timers.status CHECK constraint.

Context from BPM_Architecture_Backlog.20260611.md ISS-101:
- Section 6.6 moves a timer to status FAILED after exhausted retries
- Current migration 007 CHECK is (PENDING, FIRED, CANCELLED) -- does not include FAILED
- UPDATE to FAILED is rejected at runtime (P0 bug)

Design artefacts needed:
1. A Type C migration parameter YAML at templates/specs/iss101-timers-failed-status.migration.yaml
   - New migration (next number after GBL-080): additive ALTER TABLE timers CHECK constraint to add FAILED
   - Must be idempotent and apply to all existing tenant schemas
2. Design notes (inline in YAML or src/design/iss101-timers-failed-status.md) describing:
   - The scheduler.zig call site that writes FAILED status
   - Any error set changes needed in scheduler.zig
acceptance_criteria: Migration adds FAILED to timers.status CHECK constraint
Design notes the scheduler.zig call site that uses FAILED status

result.summary: Produced Type C migration YAML for ISS-101. The YAML extends the timers.status CHECK constraint to include FAILED alongside the existing pending/fired/cancelled values. Design notes inline document the idempotency strategy (DO block to drop old constraint before adding new), per-tenant application context, and the scheduler.zig call site note for ISS-303. Codegen dry-run and lint both exit 0.
